name: node-files-from-db-ledger-query-cost
body: `node_files_from_db` now costs one extra ledger query per call: it reads `pending_removals` (one connection open plus one `MATCH (n:PendingRemoval) RETURN n.fqn ORDER BY n.fqn`) and builds a `BTreeSet` before filtering the reconstructed rows. On a clean handle the ledger is empty, so the steady-state cost is one cheap statement; upgrade to a single projection joined against the ledger if reconstruction becomes hot — for instance a per-mutation admission over a large durable spec.
